WhatsApp filters can be combined with: Location Category Order Value Date Label Source 4. Order Value Options: Above ₹10K, Above ₹50K, Above ₹100K Only one option can be selected at a time. Filters leads based on stated order value. Cannot be combined with Foreign location. 5. Product / Category User may filter by Product or Category. Popup with search + selection appears. Selected items are reflected both in dropdown and as chips below upfront filters. 6.Leads Type: Leads Type section displays 4 options — All, Received, Posted, Bulk with "All" selected by default. On selecting "Received" only received enquiry leads are shown, "Posted" shows only seller-as-buyer leads, "Bulk" shows only bulk enquiry leads with their respective chips appearing in 3rd line. Tapping the cross on any active chip resets the listing to All leads with no chip visible in 3rd line. Only one Leads Type option can be selected at a time — selecting a new option automatically deselects the previous one. 7. Date Options: Last Week, Month (This/Previous/Last Previous), Year (2015+), Custom Date Can filter by Lead Date or Activity Date. Only one date option can be applied at a time. Appears as chip in the third line. 8. Labels Categories: Default, Users, User Defined. Only one label type can be selected at a time. Selected label appears as chip in listing screen. Buttons Behavior Apply: Applies filters, returns to LMS listing screen. Displays applied filters as chips. Highlights overlapping upfront filters (e.g., WhatsApp, Location). Clear All: Removes all selections. Resets to default. Clears chips from listing. Cancel: Exits filter screen without applying. Keeps previously applied filters. Special Chip Behavior (IM Insta WhatsApp) If a All Chats is selected from More Filter → the WhatsApp upfront filter should be highlighted.

Filter Persistence Behavior in LMS 1. Filter Application on Listing Screen When a filter is applied on the Lead Manager Listing Screen (LMS), the contact list dynamically refreshes to display only those leads matching the selected criteria. Filters are applied in real-time without requiring a manual refresh. 2. Filters with Search If a user performs a search query and then applies a filter: The filter is applied only on the search results. Leads outside the search scope should not appear, even if they match the filter conditions. Example: Search = “Shoes” → 20 leads displayed. Apply “India” location filter → only leads containing “Shoes” + located in India are displayed. 3. Pull-to-Refresh with Active Filters If user performs a pull-to-refresh action on the LMS listing screen: The active filters should persist. Newly updated leads should display, but only those that match the active filters. Filters are not cleared during pull-to-refresh. 4. Persistence Across Tabs Filters remain active when navigating between different LMS tabs: All, BuyLeads, Calls, Orders (and WhatsApp for IM Insta sellers). Example: If “Location = India” is applied in All tab: Navigating to BuyLeads tab → no filters should be applied there (default listing shown). Returning back to All tab → the “India” filter remains applied. Ensures filtering continuity across tabs. 5. Persistence Across Conversation Views If user opens a conversation from LMS and then returns to the listing: The previously applied filters remain intact. The filtered contact list continues to display without resetting. 6. Filters Reset on Exiting LMS If user navigates away from LMS (e.g., to Dashboard, Performance Report, Settings) and then returns: All filters are cleared. The default LMS listing is shown (no filters applied). Ensures a clean state when revisiting LMS after leaving it.
